headline: Infineon lists internships and graduate roles for AMS model verification
fact: Infineon posted Graduate - Analog Mixed-Signal Design Verification Engineer role HRC1763746 with an official September 9, 2026 date. It assigns Verilog-AMS/SystemVerilog model generation and maintenance, testbenches, nominal/corner simulation, fault injection and regressions. Related Andover and Shanghai internships observed October 5 cover behavioral models, AMS IP/SoC environments, RTL/model integration and model-quality checks. January/summer 2027 are planned employment starts. The official graduate date is the earliest verified publication among these grouped roles; the internships' first publication dates remain unconfirmed. These are hiring requirements, not deployed practices.
